UIIC Administrative Officers AO Online Form 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : United India Insurance Company Limited (UIIC) has released a Notifications for the post of Administrative Officers (AO) Scale-I (Generalist and Hindi Officer). This recruitment has been issued for 225 posts. Applications for UIIC Administrative Officers AO Recruitment 2026 will Start from 08 september 2026 & Candidate can apply till 28 September 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for UIIC Administrative Officers AO Recruitment 2026 which has given below..

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 08 September 2026
  • Last Date : 28 September 2026
  • Last Date of Fee Payment : 28 September 2026
  • Pre Exam Date : 22 October 2026
  • Mains Exam Date : 30 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General / OBC / EWS : Rs. 1000/-
  • SC / ST / PH : Rs. 250/-
  • Pay the Examination Fee Through Debit Card, Credit Card, Net Banking, E Challan
